title: wg: partial-02 L522 This ignores unmerged leaves
description:
draft-ietf-mls-partial (partial-02), Annotated Commit. Editors' copy mlswg/mls-partial at 7fef7c1, L522.

Text: "Identify the next non-blank node in the recipient's direct path under the
      lowest common ancestor, using the direct path provided in the
      `receiver_membership_proof_after` field. Retrieve the private HPKE
      decryption key for this node."

Problem: This ignores unmerged leaves. If the receiver is in the unmerged_leaves of that first non-blank node, it does not hold the node's private key. The RFC 9420 resolution then targets the receiver's own leaf key.

Suggested fix: State that if the receiver's leaf index appears in that node's unmerged_leaves, the receiver uses its leaf's private encryption key instead.

Severity: medium. Verifier: narrow (The unmerged-leaves gap is real: if the receiver is listed in that node's unmerged_leaves, it does not hold the node's private key and must use its leaf key. resolution_index is supplied by the annotator as an index into encrypted_path_secret, so that part is dropped.)

From MLS audit workflow wf_581e61f8-b25 (2026-10-21). Not yet reviewed by Mark; nothing posted upstream.
